name: aircad
description: Draft and model in Aircad, the 2D and 3D CAD editor, from a conversation: read the drawing you have open, build models and drawing sets as drafts you review, and make reusable commands.

interface.longDescription:
Aircad is a 2D and 3D CAD editor that runs in the browser. Connect it to work in the drawing you have open: ask what is in it, measure and check it, build 3D models from a description, sketch, or reference image, lay out drawing sets with viewports, sections, dimensions, and title blocks, and turn a repeated task into a command you can run again.

Every change arrives as a draft. You see it tinted on the canvas and apply or discard it in Aircad, so nothing changes in your file until you say so. Aircad asks before an assistant reads a file for the first time, and the assistant works only in the files you allow.

For anyone who drafts or models: architects, engineers, product designers, fabricators, and students. You need an Aircad account, and the file must be open in Aircad in a browser tab or the desktop app. An assistant can't delete, rename, move, or share your files.
capabilities: Model in 2D and 3D as drafts you review
